properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-08-21. The same structural blind spot was found in THREE INDEPENDENT PLACES in one day, and that it arose independently is the finding rather than the coincidence.

THE SHAPE, stated once: a computation that takes THE DESIGN as its only input can report on what the design mentions and on nothing else. Absence is then unreportable BY CONSTRUCTION, not by oversight — no amount of care in writing the check helps, because the missing thing never enters the data structure.

THE THREE:

  1. `arrival_delta` decided delivery by looking for an Artifact. Work whose deliverable was a DESIGN CHANGE had no file to find, so an epoch with both capabilities genuinely delivered reported both `outstanding` — a false statement about finished work, re-asked on every run. Fixed by Capability.delivery (#268).

  2. `tools/wall_check.py` walked component -> files from REALIZES. A file nobody registered never entered the map, so it could not be reported — while the tool's own headline number, '64 of 73 mapped', read as a coverage story. FIFTEEN real source modules sat outside the model, including one (skills_tools) that this agent had itself skipped while modelling its eleven siblings. Fixed by deriving the walk roots FROM THE CLAIMED PATHS, which keeps the no-configuration property.

  3. `tools/reflow2_check.py`, the CI gate, builds its observation list with `for art in artifacts` and never walks the disk; `reconcile_artifacts` does no file I/O at all. `undocumented_addition` was therefore a drift kind THE GATE STRUCTURALLY COULD NOT PRODUCE — add a file, commit, push, and every check stayed green. Fixed the same way, as a NOTE rather than a failure.

WHY IT IS ONE FINDING AND NOT THREE BUGS: nobody copied the mistake between them. Three different authors' code, three different purposes, converging on the same stance because reading from the graph is the natural way to write a check in this system — and it is the stance that cannot see absence. A fourth instance should be expected wherever a new check is written, and the question that catches it is: WHAT IS THIS CHECK'S ONLY INPUT, AND WHAT CAN THAT INPUT NEVER MENTION?

DISTINCT FROM `fact:ten-components-report-a-zero-blast-radius-the-source-contradicts` (2026-08-20), which named the same stance in the DETECTORS. What today adds is that it is not a detector property: it reached an INSTRUMENT and a GATE, which are different code with different authors. It is an architectural stance of the product, not a defect class in one subsystem.

WHAT IT COSTS AN ARBITRARY USER'S PROJECT: every reassuring number reflow2 gives about coverage, cycles or blast radius is computed over what the user already told it. A project that has modelled half its code gets confident answers about that half and silence about the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two.
